title: Juicy Mediterranean Frankfurter Wrap
description: An earthy and comforting mediterranean dish featuring frankfurters wrapped in a whole30-friendly wrap with added vegetables for a nutritious snack or light meal.
instructions: Slice tomatoes and red onions into thin rounds.
Place frankfurter sausages on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle olive oil over the sausages, season with salt, and sprinkle capers evenly across them.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until crispy and golden brown.
While sausages are roasting, place tortilla wraps on a clean surface to warm up by heat or in microwave for about 30 seconds.
To assemble the wrap, spread a small amount of roasted tomato sauce over each warmed tortilla, followed by slices of frankfurter sausage and onion round, then capers and parsley.
Fold one side of the wrap towards you, roll from the bottom to top, pinch the sides closed for a neat seal. Repeat with remaining ingredients until all are used up.
Serve hot as is or garnish with extra olive oil and fresh parsley for a pop of color.
